title: Saffron Semolina Pilaf
description: A flavorful and aromatic Indian-inspired pilaf dish, infused with saffron and served with lightly simmered vegetables.

ingredients.name: Simmered vegetables
ingredients.notes: such as peas, carrots, and cauliflower

instructions: Heat ghee or oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add chopped onion, minced garlic, and chopped green chilies. Sauté until onion is lightly browned.
Add semolina and sauté for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add 2 cups of water and stir until semolina is well combined. Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 10-12 minutes, or until semolina is cooked and fluffy.
Stir in chopped cilantro and simmer for an additional 2 minutes.
Serve hot with lightly simmered vegetables.
Garnish with additional cilantro, if desired.
